notes.title: Shadowhand Solitaire - Multi-Language Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/afa193882a6afa3257d6f6d873514bf160ed77f3.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now change language for Shadowhand Solitaire on Steam via the options screen. [/p][p]Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.[/p][p]Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.[/p][p]Enjoy playing Shadowhand Solitaire in your chosen language![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Announcing Shadowhand Solitaire! Wishlist Now.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/0445c5eefb455b53c0d5a57a449e4395392029f8.gif[/img]
[h1]NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT!
Shadowhand Solitaire is coming very soon to Steam...
We're super proud of this swashbuckling solitaire adventure and we think you'll love it![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/

Shadowhand Solitaire is a casual, solitaire-only edition of Shadowhand: RPG Card Game with no turn-based combat. Gameplay is similar to other hit games in the series: Regency Solitaire & Regency Solitaire II.
